subject: JGR not working for Mac Snow Leopard R64 2.12.1

messages.author: 8dfa9b3cb96a90ea
messages.subject: JGR not working for Mac Snow Leopard R64 2.12.1
parts:
I really enjoyed Deducer and have explored the nice interface on my
windows computer. However, it doesn't work in my Snow Leopard Macbook.
Every time I open JGR launcher, I can see the interface for 1 sec and
it immediately closes itself. I have read the information on JGR
website about the special issue of snow leopard (http://www.rforge.net/
JGR/jgr_sl.html). But it didn't help.

Here is what I have done:
1. Install R-2.12-branch-leopard.pkg from http://r.research.att.com/
2. Download 64-bit JGR launcher from Download Page (JGR-1.6-SL.dmg)
3. Open R64
4. install.packages(c("rJava","JavaGD","iplots"))
5. install.packages(c("JGR","Deducer")
6. Click on JGR launcher

Any suggestions will be appreciated!

Thanks!

messages.author: 267c7c6c510dc8a2
messages.subject: Re: JGR not working for Mac Snow Leopard R64 2.12.1
parts:
I doubt it is the problem, but you do not need to install from the r.research.att site, you can just use the usual R from CRAN. 

In R64 what do you get when you run

.libPaths()

also,

library(Deducer)
sessionInfo()

and in the terminal

java -version

When you open jgr, also have console.app open. Do you see any errors?

I have JGR running on my personal machine with snow leopard.

Best,
Ian
